note: Driven by scripts/figma/add-rail-more-seat.mjs, whose only argument is the destination board. Captured here so an applier who is not the author can execute and check it. The component-set id and four of the seven variant ids were READ from the file on 2026-09-07; the other three variants were truncated out of that dump, which is why the script iterates set.children rather than a hard-coded id list.

why: UX-F-01 (Critical). RAIL_FIGMA renders six ids (tabsConfig.ts:349-351) while TabRouter renders twelve destinations (TabRouter.tsx:125-244); Templates, Components, AI, Publish, History and Review are reachable only by a memorised letter, ⌘K, or a row in the ⋯ menu. SPEC-NAVIGATION §2.2 takes the audit's own second option — one new seat that is honestly an index — because promoting seven icons breaks the 48px pitch and the one-group reading the board commits to.
